body: Field Notes 1.0.2 shipped on 2026-10-14: CHANGELOG 1.0.2 merged via PR 309, tag v1.0.2 at cd7e3b1b, release run 38519373652 succeeded, and the GitHub release carries the dmg, the Windows installer, the APK, SHA256SUMS.txt with a verified Ed25519 signature, and appcast.xml; the Play job uploaded a draft only, and Play Console publishing stays with the owner. 1.0.2 is installed cleanly on the Windows PC (opened at onboarding) and on the Mac, and a new production relay invite was created by the owner for Mac sync setup.
